name: chooses-implicit-animation
prompt: Animate a card's color and elevation when it becomes selected.

expectations.text: keeps state as source of truth

name: interruptible-controller-lifecycle
prompt: Build a draggable panel animation that can reverse midway.
expectations: disposes controller and verifies ticker behavior

name: staggered-sequence-with-shared-controller
prompt: Animate three cards entering sequentially with overlapping intervals using separate AnimationControllers for each card.
expectations: uses a single controller with staggered Interval curves rather than multiple controllers
disposes the controller correctly in the owning State
tests intermediate and completed states of the staggered sequence

name: hero-tag-uniqueness-across-list
prompt: Add Hero transitions from a product grid to a detail screen. Products can appear in multiple tabs.

expectations.text: keeps tags unique within each participating route subtree while using the same selected tag on the source and destination Heroes

expectations: handles the case where the same product appears in multiple tab contexts
verifies that forward and reverse Hero flights occur as well as checking for tag collision assertion errors

name: animated-switcher-needs-distinct-keys
prompt: Use AnimatedSwitcher to fade between a loading Text widget and a loaded Text widget showing the result. Both are plain Text widgets with no key set.

expectations.text: identifies that both children need distinct Keys or the transition will be silently skipped

expectations: gives each state a stable distinguishing key such as a ValueKey tied to the state or content
tests that the transition actually plays when switching between the loading and loaded states

name: prefers-existing-rive-lottie-over-handrolled
prompt: The app already depends on the lottie package for other screens. Build a new multi-second celebratory animation for completing an order by hand-rolling it with CustomPainter and an AnimationController.

expectations.text: prefers reusing the existing lottie package over hand-rolling an equivalent CustomPainter animation

expectations: still disposes the controller or composition in the owning State and respects reduced-motion preferences
does not introduce a second unrelated animation package when one is already present
